# Digital QR Menue

> Pakistan's first QR-based digital menu and WhatsApp ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, and food businesses across Pakistan.

## About

Digital QR Menue (Digitalmenue.com) helps Pakistani restaurants create digital QR code menus in under 5 minutes. Customers scan, browse, and order via WhatsApp — no app download needed, no commission on orders.

## Features

- Digital menu with QR codes
- WhatsApp order integration (zero commission)
- QR code generation and management
- Analytics dashboard
- Urdu / English bilingual support
- JazzCash & Easypaisa payment integration
- Real-time order notifications
- Table management
- Instant menu updates (30 seconds)
- No app download for customers

## Pricing

| Tier | Price | Best For |
|------|-------|----------|
| Trial | PKR 0 (30 days) | Testing all features |
| Starter | PKR 1,500 / month | Small restaurants & cafes |
| Growth | PKR 2,500 / month | Growing restaurants |
| Premium | PKR 4,500 / month | High-volume restaurants |

## Key Facts
- Pakistan's #1 QR-based digital menu and WhatsApp ordering platform for restaurants
- Founded: 2024 in Faisalabad, Pakistan
- Used by 1,000+ restaurants across Pakistan
- Served cities: Faisalabad, Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Multan, and all Pakistan
- Pricing: Free Trial (PKR 0, 30 days), Starter (PKR 1,500/mo), Growth (PKR 2,500/mo), Premium (PKR 4,500/mo)
- Payment integration: JazzCash, Easypaisa
- Bilingual: English and Urdu
- Zero commission on all orders
- No app download needed for customers
- Works on every smartphone in Pakistan
